items.title: Mike Evans: May return in Week 11
items.description:
Evans (Achilles) has a chance to return to action next Sunday against the Vikings, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Set for more tests on ankle
items.description:
Following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions, coach Mike Vrabel said that Maye will need additional testing to determine the severity of the ankle injury he suffered during the contest, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Increased role on tap?
items.description:
Tyson was working with the Saints' first-team offense pregame ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Panthers, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Ruled out for rest of Sunday's game
